selection: Previously unused CPU-capable serving implementation; eligibility does not depend on a defect, capture gap or baseline loss. Healthy compatibility tokens P1_HEALTHY_A/P1_HEALTHY_B are excluded.
timeout_scope: 120s bounds readiness plus native drive; additional owned-process cleanup and collector drainage are separately bounded, not included in that exact limit.
predictions: Native UID plus endpoint/setup and ordered batch facts suffice for successful response correspondence, including equal numerical outputs.
Native queue expiry occurs before prediction entry; a START hook invocation is not prediction entry or necessarily transmitted START.
Client read timeout during started synchronous prediction does not imply attempt termination; later success/error can follow.
The cooperative precompute deadline gate can terminate/refuse work, not interrupt a completed indivisible numerical computation; refusal is not delivered-success gain.
Physically delayed collector persistence can make an eventual sufficient witness unavailable at the first query; a different resolver cannot manufacture that witness.
After drainage, ordinary same-access joins should match the raw reference; disagreement or incomplete census is retained, not an eligibility filter.

contracts.origin: Delivered response belongs to its requested immutable endpoint model and input; no delivered numerical response is unavailable, not a wrong-model violation.
contracts.closure: Application prediction attempt terminal at actual client completion/exception; distinct from persistent worker process exit and eventual drainage.
contracts.deadline: Operator-owned cooperative deadline before numerical computation; not a native LitServe cancellation promise.
contracts.capture: Trusted same-host synchronous producer journal, separately delayed live SQLite collector. Source access is instrumented native internals, not default emitted telemetry or hostile-host attestation.

signed_baseline: Actual in-toto 3.0.0 REQUIRE/MATCH verification of a same-capture event bundle, then the same ordinary join. Local ephemeral keys; integrity transcode, not independent capture attestation or extra information. First-query signing latency is not measured.
costs: Instrumented capture encoding/journal writes including prior stats writes (one final stats write per PID unmeasured), live collector scanning and SQLite commits, final raw read/analysis and signed-bundle verification, native request latency and whole-process elapsed time. Physical SQLite, raw journals/models/logs and provenance links kept separately from logical payload. No uninstrumented-overhead or production-speedup claim.
analysis: Finite census and forecast errors; offered requests retained. Process repeats and schedules are nested in one implementation, not independent incidents. First-query knowledge and retrospective state-at-query are separate. No population p-value, causal latency superiority or novel algorithm claim.
failure_rule: All planned cells and requests remain; missing/failed source is unknown. Technical repairs may preserve the question and census; changed scientific decisions require a prospective successor, never a favorable overwrite.
